name: Lord Maloquence

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Lord Maloquence may use Ruin actions and has 4 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Herald of Ruin
bonuses.text: At the start of each of Lord Maloquences turn the GM gains a point of ruin.

bonuses.name: Master of the Writ
bonuses.text: Lord Maloquence gains +4 bonus dice to all Interaction Attacks.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: Lord Maloquence has a Mark of Chaos (Undivided)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Lord Maloquence gains bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G Core Rulebook p.75)

abilities.name: Chaos made Flesh.
abilities.text: Anyone who encounters Lord Maloquence must make a DN3 Fear Test.

abilities.name: Death to the False Emperor!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to Charge, gaining +2 bonus dice to the attack Test.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks this Threat makes this Round.

note: Accursed Crozius prints no range: a melee weapon, stored [1] as Core's Painboy 'Urty Syringe. Keyword printed 'MARK OF CHAOS UNDIVIDED', kept as one.
